model_type.description: Which family of model to train.

epochs.description: Number of epochs; each one adds capacity or does another pass.

early_stopping_patience.description: Stop when validation has not improved for this many epochs; 0 disables.

seed.description: Random seed for the model (the data split has its own frozen seed).

learning_rate.description: Shrinkage applied to each boosting round; lower is slower but steadier.

max_leaf_nodes.description: Maximum leaves per tree; more leaves fit more detail.

max_depth.description: Maximum tree depth; null means unlimited.

min_samples_leaf.description: Minimum rows per leaf; higher values regularise.

l2_regularization.description: L2 penalty on leaf values; higher values regularise.

trees_per_epoch.description: Trees added to the forest each epoch.

max_depth.description: Maximum tree depth; null means grow until the leaves are pure.

min_samples_leaf.description: Minimum rows per leaf; higher values make each tree simpler.

max_features.description: Fraction of columns each split may consider; lower decorrelates trees.

learning_rate.description: Step size for each gradient update.

alpha.description: Strength of the L2 penalty on the coefficients.
